description: Build CAD (STL, and exact STEP where supported) for a cooling or flow design from a template or design document. CPU job, not charged: usually under a minute for a part, several minutes for a detailed assembly. To test parameter changes, run one design study through call_design_operation, not a build per variation. Not for editing an uploaded CAD file (use reconstruct_cad and edit_reconstructed_cad). Submit a durable geometry job from exactly one template_id or self-contained gd.design/v1 document, including complex feature graphs returned by design edits. Document assets/imported CAD references are currently unsupported; never discard them. STL/design defaults; exact STEP only when supported by every exported feature. For meshing implicit multizone geometry, set purpose=meshing, method=auto and explicit output_names to permit checked named faceted STEP volumes. Heatmaps and boundary patches are not volume regions; artifact metadata records exact versus faceted geometry. Returns job ID and immutable artifact lineage for viewing, meshing and simulation; does not approve the design or edit Studio projects. May incur compute charges.

design_brief_artifact_id.description: Immutable owned design brief used to derive this candidate; retained in job lineage

document.description: Self-contained gd.design/v1 feature graph, up to 1 MiB. Use native design catalogue/edit operations to compose it. Mutually exclusive with template_id; assets/external references are not supported. Native validity, manufacturing and exact export are checked by the worker.

idempotency_key.description: Use a fresh unique key for each newly requested job, even with identical inputs or a matching completed job. Reuse unchanged only for retries/resuming that same intended job. Never replace it to retry an uncertain submission.

method.description: Exact STEP by default. For purpose=meshing, auto permits checked faceted STEP for implicit volumes; artifacts record the actual representation.

named_stl.description: Also export each selected document body as a separate named STL, alongside the combined surface, for mesh wall patches.

notify_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL that receives a signed notification when the job finishes, so you need not poll.

purpose.description: Meshing requires explicit volume output_names; heatmaps, boundary patches and display helpers are rejected by the geometry engine.

template_id.description: Registered template; mutually exclusive with document

name: create_geometry
title: Build geometry
